content: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
author: Nelson Mandela
story:
Imprisoned for 27 years on Robben Island and in Pollsmoor Prison, Mandela performed backbreaking labor in a lime quarry while his movement was outlawed. Rather than allowing decades of isolation to poison him with vengeance, he disciplined his mind and emerged to dismantle Apartheid without bloodshed, preaching reconciliation as the only true path to freedom.

Confronting the trials of his era, Nelson Mandela recognized that adversity is the ultimate crucible of the human spirit. Rather than seeking an easy path free from friction, he urged seekers to welcome the struggle as the very forge that tempers courage and character.
reflectionPrompt: When you look back on past hardships, how did navigating them expand your capacity for strength?
